name: n8n Chat
description: Integrates n8n chat functionality (embed an n8n-powered chat workflow) into Drupal.
project_description:
A Drupal module that integrates n8n chat widget functionality into your Drupal site, providing seamless chat experiences powered by n8n workflows.

 Features 
 
 Easy Integration : Simple setup with n8n webhook URLs 
 Flexible Placement : Use as a global widget or place specific blocks 
 Responsive Design : Works on desktop and mobile devices 
 Customizable Appearance : Light/dark themes and custom CSS support 
 Session Management : Automatic session tracking with unique session IDs 
 Conversation History : Persistent sessions with 24-hour expiry 
 New Conversation : Users can start fresh conversations anytime 
 AI Integration : Works with Drupal's AI Chatbot module 
 User Context : Optional user information sharing with n8n workflows 
 
 Development with Generative AI 
 This module was primarily generated and is maintained using generative AI tools. This approach enables:

 
 Rapid Development : Quick iteration and feature implementation 
 Code Quality : AI-assisted code review and optimization 
 Documentation : Comprehensive and up-to-date documentation 
 Best Practices : Adherence to Drupal coding standards and security practices
